community_list_entries.name: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations

phase1_classification.kind_reason: It releases ten real user-AI companion relationships (27,218 messages over up to 120 days) with profiles and personas. It includes 1,533 scoreable chat probes and 3,235 scoreable questions with evidence pointers. It tests distant-memory use, deciding when the past matters, and persona reconstruction
